name: Pan-Seared Halibut with Citrus Butter Sauce & Parmesan-Asparagus

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ oranges

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Divide between two baking sheets, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place asparagus in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until tender, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the halibut dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg halibut fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Working in batches if necessary, add halibut and pan-fry, turning once, until lightly browned and just cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Peel and mince shallots and garlic.
Juice lemons and oranges into a small bowl.
Remove asparagus from the oven and sprinkle with half of the Parmesan. Return to the oven and bake until cheese is melted and golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Transfer the cooked halibut to a clean plate and cover with foil. Return skillet to medium heat.
Add shallot and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, about 1 minute.
Add citrus juice and butter to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits. Cook, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens slightly, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide asparagus, halibut, and citrus sauce between plates. Top with remaining Parmesan and enjoy!
